title: Threads in the Rain
short_summary: A haunted detective, Jack Malone, unravels a web of lies, murder, and betrayal in rain-soaked New Harbor. Each clue draws him deeper into the city's darkness, where every truth is stained and every ally suspect.
world_context: New Harbor, a 1940s-inspired city of rain, neon, jazz clubs, and corruption. The world is gritty, atmospheric, and steeped in noir sensibilities—smoke-filled rooms, flickering streetlights, and secrets lurking in every shadow.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face with a perpetual five o'clock shadow, limp in left leg, sharp blue eyes, graying at the temples
quirks: Always carries a battered silver dollar
Drinks whiskey from a chipped mug
characters.typical_attire: Dark trenchcoat, fedora, wrinkled suit, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Once a rising star in the force, Jack was broken by a case gone wrong. Haunted by guilt over his partner Eddie's death, he now works as a private detective, driven by a need for redemption.
characters.motivations: To uncover the truth behind Eddie's murder and expose the corruption infecting the city, no matter the personal cost.

characters.name: Veronica Ash
characters.physical_traits: Striking, with dark wavy hair, pale skin, expressive green eyes, always perfectly made up, hands often gloved
quirks: Bracelets cover a scar on her wrist
characters.typical_attire: Elegant black dress, pearl necklace, silk gloves, high heels
characters.backstory: A jazz singer at the Black Lotus Club, Veronica is entangled in the city's criminal underbelly. Her brother Eddie's death shattered her composure, and she hides secrets behind her poised exterior.
characters.motivations: To protect her brother's memory and survive the dangerous games of New Harbor's elite.

characters.name: Tommy Russo
characters.physical_traits: Stocky build, slicked-back dark hair, heavy brow, nervous eyes, always wearing gloves
quirks: Fidgets with a rabbit's foot keychain
Whistles opera arias under his breath
characters.typical_attire: Cheap suit, leather gloves, scuffed boots
characters.backstory: A small-time enforcer with a gambling problem, Tommy is caught between loyalty and fear. His connections to Eddie and Morrison make him both a suspect and a pawn.
characters.motivations: To clear his debts and escape the city's tightening noose.

characters.name: Captain Morrison
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, graying hair, cold steel-gray eyes, deep lines etched by stress
quirks: Keeps a hidden flask in his desk
characters.typical_attire: Police captain's uniform, polished shoes, heavy overcoat
characters.backstory: A once-respected police captain, Morrison has grown corrupt, manipulating evidence and protecting his own interests. His involvement in Eddie's murder is buried beneath layers of deceit.
characters.motivations: To maintain his power and cover up his crimes, even if it means silencing those who get too close.

characters.name: Eddie Ash
characters.physical_traits: Thin, bespectacled, nervous energy, ink-stained fingers, gentle smile
characters.backstory: Veronica's younger brother, Eddie was a bookkeeper with a knack for getting into trouble. His murder is the catalyst for Jack's investigation.
characters.motivations: In life: to protect his sister and escape his debts. In death: to have his story told.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack Malone, haunted by contradictions and clues, holes up in his office to piece together the tangled web of the case. He reviews evidence, relives memories, and pushes the investigation forward by sending glove fibers to the lab. The night deepens, and so does Jack's resolve.

scenes.scene_description: Jack pores over his notebook, surrounded by evidence and contradictions. He reflects on the lies and gaps in the case, each clue a thread in a web.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Establishing shot of Jack's cramped office at night, rain streaking the window. Desk cluttered with papers, a battered notebook open, evidence scattered: lipstick-stained glass, torn ledger page, glove fiber in a plastic bag. Dim desk lamp casts harsh shadows. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack sits at his desk, surrounded by evidence.

dialogue.text: Contradictions everywhere. Every clue a thread ready to snap.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues and grays with sharp yellow lamp light

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack hunched over his desk, pen in hand, brow furrowed. The city glows faintly through rain-blurred glass behind him. Evidence items—ledger page, glove fiber—spread before him. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack writes in his notebook, lost in thought.

dialogue.text: Veronica’s lies. Tommy’s alibi. Morrison’s missing hours.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand gripping a chipped mug, whiskey swirling inside. The silver dollar glints between his fingers. Raindrops streak the window in the blurred background. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack holds his mug, silver dollar warm in his palm.

dialogue.text: Every detail matters. Every memory stings.

pages.page_description: Jack’s office at night, evidence and contradictions weighing on him.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack staring out the rain-streaked window, city lights blurred beyond. His reflection is faint, haunted. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack gazes into the city, lost in memory.

dialogue.text: The city never sleeps. Neither do regrets.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s notebook: pages filled with scribbled names, arrows, and question marks. The lipstick-stained glass and torn ledger page are visible beside it. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack reviews his notes, connecting clues.

dialogue.text: Every thread leads somewhere. Or nowhere.

pages.page_description: Jack’s reflection and his obsessive note-taking, clues swirling in his mind.

scenes.scene_description: Jack’s mind flickers through memories: Veronica’s trembling hands, Tommy’s gloved touch, Morrison’s threats, Eddie alive and humming jazz.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up memory: Veronica’s hands tremble as she lights a cigarette, gloves slipping slightly to reveal pale skin. Background is a smoky jazz club, blurred. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Veronica’s hands shake, betraying her nerves.
panels.color_palette: smoky grays, pale skin, red lipstick

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up memory: Tommy’s gloved hand clenching into a fist, veins bulging beneath leather. Dim light, background out of focus. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Tommy’s gloved fist tightens, regret in his posture.

dialogue.text: Tommy’s regret—hidden behind leather and silence.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up memory: Morrison’s face, cold and threatening, eyes narrowed. Harsh light from below casts deep shadows. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Morrison’s cold threat lingers in Jack’s mind.

pages.page_description: Jack’s memories: Veronica’s nerves, Tommy’s regret, Morrison’s threats.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium memory: Eddie, alive, sits at a piano in a smoky club, humming jazz, eyes bright with life. Warm light spills over the keys. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Eddie hums jazz at the piano, alive in memory.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up memory: Jack’s knee, scarred and tense, rain trickling down his pant leg as he stands in a puddle outside. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack’s knee throbs with memory and rain.

dialogue.text: Old wounds ache in the rain.

pages.page_description: Eddie’s memory and Jack’s physical pain—past and present intertwined.

scenes.scene_description: Jack calls the city lab, requesting a rush analysis on the glove fibers. He is terse, determined.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack at his desk, phone receiver pressed to his ear, eyes narrowed. The city lab’s number is scrawled on a notepad. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack makes a tense phone call to the lab.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand holding a plastic evidence bag with glove fibers, the city lab’s address visible on a slip inside. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack prepares the glove fibers for analysis.

dialogue.text: No time for mistakes. The city’s watching.

scenes.scene_description: As night deepens, Jack’s certainty grows. He reflects on the lies and truths, the city’s darkness pressing in.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack slumped at his desk, city lights flickering through the rain outside. His notebook lies open, pen dropped beside it. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack sits exhausted, the weight of the case heavy.

dialogue.text: Every lie hides another. Every truth is stained.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s tired eyes, reflected in the rain-streaked window, city lights blurred behind him. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack’s reflection in the window, resolve hardening.

dialogue.text: The city’s darkness is endless. But so is my resolve.

pages.page_description: Jack’s exhaustion and determination as the city’s darkness presses in.
